Suchformular – die Abfrage hinter dem Su: Search form – the query behind the search box
Niemand tippt in einer App SQL. Man füll: Nobody types SQL in an app. You fill in a form – and the program builds the query from it. Each field puts its value in a certain place after WHERE: this is called a parameterised query. Today you build such a form for your matchmaking site.
Eine Seite mit Feldern zum Ausfüllen und: A page with fields to fill in and a button to send it.
A box you write something into.
Ein Feld, in dem man aus vorgegebenen We: A field where you choose from given values.
Eine Stelle in der Abfrage, an die späte: A place in the query where the input goes later, e.g. :sucht.
Die Abfrage hat Platzhalter, die mit den: The query has placeholders that are filled with the input.

Hinter jedem Suchformular steht eine Abf: Behind every search form there is a query with placeholders after WHERE – a parameterised query.

Warum schreibt man die Abfrage mit Platz: Why do you write the query with placeholders instead of writing it new every time?
Weil das Programm so für jede Eingabe di: Because that way the program uses the same, tested query for every input
It is about safety and order.
Einmal geschrieben, für alle Eingaben be: Written once, used for all inputs – and the inputs are put in safely.

Sie hat genau getan, was in der Abfrage: It did exactly what was in the query.
The input became part of the SQL command. This is called SQL injection – one of the most common security holes.
Eingaben nie in den SQL-Text kleben, son: Never stick input into the SQL text, pass it through placeholders (parameters) instead
Mit Platzhaltern bleibt die Eingabe imme: With placeholders the input always stays just a value – never part of the command. That is why your form builder puts quotation marks in input safely.
